experience.description: Led the development of a real-time deployment analytics dashboard used by 40,000+ teams. Architected a React/Next.js front-end with a Rust-backed API layer, reducing p95 load times by 62%.

Built core features of the issue-tracking interface including keyboard-first navigation, bulk actions, and a custom rich-text editor. Collaborated directly with design to establish the component library used across the entire product.

Developed and maintained the Stripe Dashboard's reporting module, handling billions of dollars in transaction data. Introduced accessibility improvements that brought the module to WCAG AA compliance.
Delivered 15+ client websites and web apps across e-commerce, SaaS, and media verticals. Gained rapid exposure to full project lifecycles from discovery through deployment.

project-details.label: Problem
project-details.detail: Content teams were spending 5–8 hours per week manually planning and scheduling posts across multiple platforms with no unified view.

project-details.label: Solution
project-details.detail: A unified AI-assisted calendar that ingests brand guidelines, past performance data, and audience insights to suggest optimal posting schedules.

project-details.label: My Role
project-details.detail: Solo founder-engineer for the first 6 months: product strategy, full-stack development, UI/UX design, and user research.

project-details.label: Tech Stack
project-details.detail: Next.js 14 App Router, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, OpenAI GPT-4o, Tailwind CSS, Vercel.

project-details.label: Outcome
project-details.detail: 60% reduction in weekly planning time reported by beta users; 94% of AI-suggested schedules accepted without modification after onboarding.

project-details.label: Key Learning
project-details.detail: Streaming AI responses with the Vercel AI SDK dramatically improved perceived performance and user trust compared to waiting for full completions.
